full_judgment:
Muhammad Imman Ali, J. This Civil Petition for leave to appeal is directed against the judgment and order dated 22.11.2009 passed by a Single Bench of the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 4719 of 2004 making the rule absolute setting aside the Judgment and Decree dated 14.10.2004 passed by the Senior Assistant Judge, Additional Court and Family court, Rajshahi in Small Causes court suit No. 3 of 2001 dismissing the suit for eviction of tenants. 

 5. Being aggrieved by the judgment and decree of the S.C.C. Judge, the plaintiff filed Civil Revision No. 4719 of 2004 and obtained Rule. By the impugned Judgment the High court Division made the Rule absolute setting aside he judgment and decree passed by the learned S.C.C. Judge. The defendant was directed to vacate the premises within six months from the date of the judgment, failing which the plaintiff would be at liberty to get possession of the it premises through court.
